description: An impression joined to its click is handed to the host's registered sink.
source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="awaiting_click">
    <state id="awaiting_click">
        <transition event="click.recorded" target="joined">
            <send type="myapp:sink" target="joined_records" event="impression.joined" />
        </transition>
    </state>
    <final id="joined" />
</scxml>
